overview: The Medford Community Chorale and Youth and Young Adult Chorus held their 10th live spring concert featuring a varied program of popular, folk, and theatre music. A portion of the concert proceeds was donated to the Medford Youth Center.

items.title: Opening Remarks and "You're the Inspiration"
items.summary: Director Betsy introduced the concert and announced that proceeds would support the Medford Youth Center before the chorus performed Chicago's "You're the Inspiration."

items.title: "Shenandoah"
items.summary: The full chorus performed an arrangement of the traditional American folk song "Shenandoah."

items.title: Hair Medley ("Age of Aquarius")
items.summary: The chorus performed a medley of songs from the musical Hair featuring guest soloist Monty Hill.

items.title: "For Good"
items.summary: The chorus performed the ballad "For Good" from the musical Wicked.

items.title: "You Raise Me Up"
items.summary: The chorus performed the ballad "You Raise Me Up."

items.title: Youth and Young Adult Chorus Set
items.summary: The Youth and Young Adult Chorus performed a set featuring "Here Comes the Sun," "Somewhere Out There," "California Dreamin'," "Take Me Home, Country Roads," and "Swinging on a Star."

items.title: Combined Chorus Medleys
items.summary: The combined choruses performed "I Believe" along with a medley of Michael Jackson's "Heal the World" and "We Are the World."

items.title: "One Voice"
items.summary: Alumni singers joined the chorus to perform Barry Manilow's "One Voice."

items.title: Full Chorus Standards Set
items.summary: The main chorus performed "Thank You for the Music," "What a Wonderful World," "The Greatest Love of All," and "New York, New York."

items.title: Recognitions, Raffle, and "God Bless America"
items.summary: Speakers recognized director Betsy and accompanist Holly, called out raffle prize winners, and led the audience in singing "God Bless America" to close the concert.
